name: Rayna Auto-Dialer
description: Automates the repetitive parts of the Rayna CRM outbound-calling workflow. Personal load-unpacked tool: never logs in, never sends messages or emails.

mark-voicemail.description: Connected call: it's voicemail (hang up, log Left Voicemail, next)

mark-live.description: Connected call: live human (freeze for manual handling)

prestage.description: Connected call: pre-stage WhatsApp + Gmail drafts (never sends)

skip-lead.description: Connected call: hang up and advance without logging

mark-not-interested.description: Connected call: not interested (log Not Interested, save, next)

resume-session.description: Resume dialing after a Live / Pre-stage / error freeze

quit-session.description: Stop the session (finishes logging the current lead first)
